summary: Infant daughter of the Birkenmayers of Munzingen in Baden who died in 1839; John's 4th great-aunt.
bio: Rosa Birkenmayer was born in 1839 at Munzingen, Freiburg im Breisgau, Baden-Württemberg, Germany, and died there in infancy the same year. She was a sister of Maria Anna Birkenmayer, and John's 4th great-aunt.
